fusions.name: Snapping Hold
fusions.desc: Clamps your jaws onto the target: it deals 10 damage, stuns it for 1.2 seconds and leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Wrench the Wound
fusions.desc: Wrenches at an enemy up to 3.5 tiles away that carries one of your afflictions, which deals 9 damage and uses up that affliction.

fusions.name: Every Collar Seized
fusions.desc: Pulls up to 4 enemies within 5 tiles onto you for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Braced Grip
fusions.desc: When you spend stamina, you brace inside your shell and gain a ward worth 10% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
